correctness.rationale: Exact scalar rotational reduction of the Loewner matrix Hessian gives a 2×2 matrix with nonnegative diagonals and determinant polynomial. The discriminant 16R²(1+R)²(R²−4R−2) proves positive semidefiniteness exactly on R≤2+sqrt(6). A strict negative eigenvalue above that radius supplies infinitesimal Jensen failure; a uniform two-sphere center construction makes every sufficiently small counterexample an actual positive-length smooth mixed fiber. The graph metric gives curvature ≥1 precisely when the matrix midpoint deficit is positive semidefinite. The symbolic checker reruns all critical identities from included verify.py; no infinite result is inferred from floating point.
